assessments.reasoning: Section 6.2.8 requires observers to agree on modifications to each atomic object during shader-stage execution. The same-value write counts as a modification under the definition.

challenge.method: Compare two interleavings of writes to objects x and y that preserve each per-object projection. Contrast an optional vector atomic and scope differences in the neighboring rules.
challenge.results: Both interleavings preserve x1 then x2 and y1 then y2 while disagreeing on the overall cross-object order. The draft expressly gives no causality across objects. The separate vector extension and address-space requirements do not broaden this scalar claim.

limitations: The claim concerns valid scalar atomic objects and their modification operations. It does not assign a cross-object order or a stronger memory guarantee.
